en: Vintage sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a wide agricultural valley with gridded fields, orchards, scattered farm buildings, and small town structures, viewed from an elevated vantage point (Slover Mountain). Snow‑capped mountains form the background. The image is bordered by a light frame with red printed captions including the title along the bottom and publisher/production details along the sides, plus a red handwritten or printed number in the lower-right corner.
